IMPLEMENTATION NOTE: This sheet defines client-side conditional prompts, provenance/status rules and expected writing locations. It does not itself generate student text, inspect their actual Word document, or run a website.

The course/syllabus decision is separate from independent research. Familiar mathematics needs correct application, purpose and interpretation—not a tutorial. An original mathematical insight can be noted where it emerges, but only when genuine.
